name: apprenti.dev Data Engineering
audience: Software or analytics engineer with working Python and SQL, specializing into pipeline engineering — moving, contracting, orchestrating and recovering data, not analyzing it.
philosophy: Evidence-driven specialization: write the contract, move the data, rerun without fear, recover from the evidence. LEARN BY DOING. GROW THROUGH MENTORSHIP.
aiPrinciples: AI assistance must be disclosed when materially used.
Tasks may restrict solution generation while allowing explanations, hints and quizzes.
The apprentice remains accountable for every load, contract, backfill and recovery they submit.
Mentor approval is based on demonstrated reruns, failure recovery and live explanation, not a single successful run.
